Author: TheLegendaryZiz
Name: ZizBestiarium
Punchline: Beastmaster autopilot: find and capture missing beasts.
Description: Tracks your Beastmaster collection, reads existing pacts from the game and plans missing creatures. Travels using unlocked aetherytes and ZizNav/vnavmesh, then uses Capture with its own single-target rotation. Duty routes use ZizDuty. Requires Windows x64, .NET 10 and Dalamud API 15. Preview: runtime behavior has not been validated. Open with /zizbest.

Author: ziz
Name: ZizDailyRoutines
Description: A customized Daily Routines package for zizi45official, with configurable task and interface helpers. Requires Dalamud/ZizLoader API 15 on Windows x64. This package has not been runtime-tested in FFXIV.
Punchline: Configurable helpers for everyday FFXIV tasks.

Author: TheLegendaryZiz
Name: AutoFate
Description: Finds level-appropriate FATEs, travels using unlocked aetherytes and navigates with ZizNav/vnavmesh. Selects combat targets for a configured combat plugin. Optional leveling-plan features integrate job quests, duties and equipment management. Requires Windows x64, .NET 10 and Dalamud/ZizLoader API 15. Review inventory cleanup settings before using shopping automation: cleanup can discard items. Open with /autofate; use /autofate start, stop or status.
Punchline: Find suitable FATEs, travel to them and earn EXP.
